A [[Forest/Legends|forested]] '''planet''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="CCG" /> The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CSWE st">{{CSWECite|III|193|Stormtrooper}} establishes that all [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="SE">{{StoryCite|story=Soldiers of the Empire!|book=Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 4}} establishes that all [[clone stormtrooper]]s were [[Gender/Legends|males]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref> [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="TCG">{{TCG|set=Return of the Jedi|cardname=Scout Trooper|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/ROTJ/Scout_Trooper.webp?v=2}}</ref> [[Irol]] hailed from this [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="CCG" /> He learned how to fly a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|115|Irol, Sergeant}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Irol became an Imperial [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]<ref name="CCG" /> by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was first mentioned in Sergeant Irol's [[1999]] card for the ''[[Endor Limited]]'' set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />
